instructions.title: Login & Basic Access
instructions.description: Confirm login nodes and user-facing hosts are reachable.
instructions.good: Successful login and filesystem access on all tested hosts.
instructions.bad: Login failures, timeouts, or inaccessible filesystems.

methods.content: SSH to SERVER and verify a normal prompt appears.
SSH to a random selection of user-facing nodes.
Confirm home directories and shared filesystems are accessible.

instructions.title: Home Directory & User Quota + Filesystem Experience
instructions.description: Verify quota system and test home filesystem performance.
instructions.good: Usage below limits and filesystem tests complete quickly.
instructions.bad: Quota issues or poor filesystem performance.

methods.content:
Run:
```sh
quota -s
```

Run:
```sh
df -h ~
```
Perform block and metadata filesystem tests using dd and touch.
Create a large test file and verify quota reporting updates correctly.

instructions.title: Scratch / Lustre Storage + Filesystem Experience
instructions.description: Verify scratch storage quotas and Lustre performance.
instructions.bad: Filesystem issues, errors, or slow performance.

methods.content:
Run:
```sh
lfs quota PATH TO SCRATCH USERS/$USER
```
Verify scratch directory contents are accessible.
Perform large file write and metadata performance tests.
Confirm filesystem performance and quota reporting are acceptable.

instructions.title: Slurm Scheduler Status
instructions.description: Confirm scheduler responsiveness and node availability.
instructions.good: Nodes visible and scheduler operating normally.

methods.content:
Run:
```sh
sinfo -Nl
```
Review partition information using scontrol show partitions.
Inspect nodes using scontrol show node.
Review running jobs and investigate a sample job where possible.

instructions.title: GPU / Compute Node Availability
instructions.description: Validate GPU node health and availability.
instructions.bad: Missing nodes or unhealthy GPU resources.

methods.content: Review node status using sinfo.
SSH to a selection of GPU nodes and verify responsiveness.
Submit an interactive GPU job and run nvidia-smi health checks.
Inspect a node currently running a GPU workload.

instructions.title: Light Test Job Submission
instructions.description: Verify jobs can be submitted and completed.

methods.content: Run a simple CPU test job with srun.
Monitor queue status using squeue -u $USER.
Submit a small batch script and confirm successful completion.

instructions.title: Services & Environment
instructions.description: Verify Slurm commands and environment modules.

methods.content:
Run:
```sh
module avail
```

Run:
```sh
which srun
```

Run:
```sh
squeue
```

instructions.title: Cleanup & Verification
instructions.good: No jobs or files left behind.
instructions.bad: Residual jobs, files, or quota usage.

methods.content: Check for active jobs using squeue -u $USER.
Check for active jobs using squeue -u $USER.
Run quota and verify usage has returned to normal.

instructions.title: Final Notes / Escalation
instructions.description: Record outcome and escalate issues if required.

methods.content: If all checks pass, log: "Daily user check complete - no issues".
For any RED item, escalate to OPS with exact command output.
